description: This file defines a mock class for the ISharedMemoryBufferFactory interface used in testing. It includes mock method declarations for creating shared memory buffers, and is part of the Rialto server media testing suite.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISharedMemoryBufferFactory interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: createSharedMemoryBuffer
